title: BAQualityGateAuditResult
description: Binary mechanical quality gate audit schema for BA requirements documentation under IIBA BABOK standards.

verdict.description: Final mechanical gate decision. APPROVED only if overall_score >= 85 and no CRITICAL violations exist.

taxonomy_compliance.description: Score measuring BABOK 4-tier separation: BR has no features, SR has personas, FR has action verbs, TR covers cutover/migration.

smart_nfr_rigor.description: Score measuring whether 100% of NFRs have physical/engineering metrics and zero unquantified adjectives.

traceability_coverage.description: Score measuring bidirectional RTM completeness (No orphaned goals and no gold-plating).

transition_readiness.description: Score measuring readiness for data migration, rollback, operational training, and cutover.

detected_vague_adjectives.description: List of qualitative/vague adjectives detected without numeric bounds (e.g., 'nhanh', 'ổn định', 'an toàn', 'mượt mà').

has_prohibited_actions_defined.description: Whether the document explicitly specifies what the system/agent is FORBIDDEN to do (Negative Space).

prohibited_items.description: List of explicit negative rules or prohibitions identified in the requirements.

violations_found.description: Any negative space rules that were breached or missing.

location.description: Section, header or line reference where the issue is found.

issue.description: Precise description of the flaw or standard deviation.

actionable_fix.description: Concrete instruction on how to remediate the defect.

violations.description: Detailed list of all defects detected during the mechanical gate audit.

summary.description: High-level summary assessment of the requirements document readiness.
